name: item_code
description: Eight-character MDRM identifier, the concatenation of mnemonic and item number

name: mnemonic
description: First four characters of the identifier, naming the report series and the consolidation basis, such as RCON for domestic offices or RCFD for consolidated domestic and foreign offices

name: item_number
description: Last four characters of the identifier, naming the item itself; the same number carries the same meaning across reporting forms

name: name
description: Item name as published in the MDRM data dictionary

name: description
description: Full item definition as published in the MDRM

name: item_type
description: MDRM item type: F financial, D derived, R rate, P percentage, S structure, E examination, J projected

name: measurement_unit
description: Unit of the values carried for this item in call_report_item and holding_company_item
observations: Derived here, not published by the MDRM, which does not separate dollar amounts from counts. USD, percent, ratio, unit, or blank when the item is a yes/no answer, an indicator or a date rather than a quantity.

name: is_flag
description: Whether the item is a yes/no answer or an indicator code rather than a magnitude, 1 for yes

name: is_confidential
description: Whether the MDRM marks the item as confidential and therefore not publicly disclosed, 1 for yes

name: reporting_form
description: Reporting forms that collect the item, separated by semicolons

name: start_date
description: First date on which the item was collected

name: end_date
description: Last date on which the item was collected
observations: 9999-12-31 marks an item that is still collected.

name: series_glossary
description: MDRM glossary entry for the mnemonic
